title: Main board - JP5 power header and the J8 end: bench hookup (raptox's unit, mosaic 2026-11-03)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)

callouts.label: JP5 pin 1 (square), VIN
callouts.note: Bench supply +5.0 V (OVP 6 V, current limit 100 mA, then 500 mA). Recorder: 20k/10k divider to ESP32 GPIO39. Never above 6 V. The square pad, '1' printed left of it (J-077, J-080).

callouts.label: JP5 pin 2, GND
callouts.note: Bench supply minus; FTDI GND / ESP32 GND. The round pad, '2' printed left of it (J-080).

callouts.label: Test point, VIN
callouts.note: VIN check point: rings to JP5 pin 1 (J-097). Left of JP5, below C19.

callouts.label: Test point, GND
callouts.note: Rings to JP5 pin 2 (J-097). Below its label, between U6 and R578.

callouts.label: Test point, GND
callouts.note: Rings to JP5 pin 2 (J-101). Below J8's pin-1 end; its label is printed upside down.

callouts.label: J8 pin-1 end (circle)
callouts.note: The FFC stays OUT of J8 in every bench session. The printed circle marks pin 1, the lowest contact tail; pins 1-6 are the VIN group (J-077).

callouts.label: J8 actuator
callouts.note: Cable out; no J8 signal is used by the bench procedures. The white flip actuator on the right of the 30-way FFC connector.

callouts.label: Test point, GND
callouts.note: Rings to JP5 pin 2 (J-097). Above J8's pin-30 end.
